recommendations.main_issue: Customers are experiencing unhelpful support responses, refusal of proper refunds for missing or undelivered items, and a frustrating reliance on an ineffective AI assistant.
recommendations.recommendation: If the product team introduces a streamlined workflow for handling delivery fraud and missing item claims with human agents instead of rigid AI assistants, then customer satisfaction scores and support resolution rates will improve.
recommendations.trade_off: Allocating more human agent resources to complex delivery and refund disputes may increase operational handling times for overall support tickets.
recommendations.success_metric: Weekly share of reviews in the customer support theme

I called him multiple times, but he did not answer. Customer support refused to refund me without properly investigating the issue. This appears to be a serious delivery fraud and Swiggy should investigate such cases instead of

recommendations.main_issue: Orders take excessively long to arrive or get severely delayed due to late partner assignment and multiple order stacking by drivers.
recommendations.recommendation: If the product team implements a feature to limit multi-order stacking during peak times and restricts order placement when delivery partners are unavailable nearby, then customer delivery times and satisfaction ratings will improve.
recommendations.trade_off: Limiting order stacking may reduce the total volume of orders a single delivery partner can complete in a shift, potentially increasing operational fulfillment costs.
recommendations.success_metric: Weekly share of reviews mentioning delivery delay

recommendations.main_issue: Customers are frustrated by hidden extra costs such as platform fees, delivery charges, and surge pricing that significantly inflate the final checkout price compared to the initial item cost.
recommendations.recommendation: If the product team provides a transparent upfront cost breakdown on the menu or item page before users add items to the cart, then customer trust and satisfaction regarding pricing will improve.
recommendations.trade_off: Displaying higher total costs upfront may reduce initial cart additions and order completion rates for users sensitive to extra fees.
recommendations.success_metric: Weekly share of reviews in the high pricing theme

recommendations.main_issue: Customers are frustrated by the 100% cancellation fee and the lack of a grace period for cancelling orders immediately after placement.
recommendations.recommendation: If the product team introduces a short grace period allowing free or low-fee cancellations within a minute of order placement, then customer satisfaction scores for order management will improve.
recommendations.trade_off: Allowing fee-free cancellations shortly after placement may increase the operational and financial burden on partner restaurants that have already begun preparing the food.
recommendations.success_metric: Weekly share of reviews mentioning the cancellation policy theme
